dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: So quiet, and cozy... This is a really great place to catch up on sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah — please don't tell Lady Guuji I'm here... If she finds out, I'm toast!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: If there are no more battles today, can I chill out here a little longer?
